corrections_applied.correction_1_status_default: Newly registered dataset versions and records default strictly to UNKNOWN (not OFFICIAL). No dataset becomes OFFICIAL merely by being registered.
corrections_applied.correction_2_source_authority_vs_data_st: Source Authority (constitutional, statutory, academic, media_ngo, crowdsourced, synthetic_model) is explicitly decoupled from Data Status (OFFICIAL, DERIVED, VERIFIED, ESTIMATE, SCENARIO, INFERRED, UNVERIFIED, UNKNOWN). Authoritative sources do not automatically confer OFFICIAL status.
corrections_applied.correction_3_geography_source_reconcilia: Unsupported claim of 'Survey of India / 2008 Delimitation -> OFFICIAL' removed. Actual observed source 'datta07/INDIAN-SHAPEFILES' (from data/geo/ATTRIBUTION.md) recorded with authority 'crowdsourced/open_source_repo' and status 'UNVERIFIED'.
corrections_applied.correction_4_scenario_official_invariant: Transitions from SCENARIO, ESTIMATE, INFERRED, UNVERIFIED, UNKNOWN to OFFICIAL are blocked by trigger constraints. Transition from SCENARIO to OFFICIAL is permanently prohibited.
corrections_applied.correction_5_production_impact_wording: Expected impact: additive schema design with nullable references. Production runtime impact: UNKNOWN until staging execution and verification. Production execution: NOT YET AUTHORIZED.
corrections_applied.correction_6_provenance_cardinality: Supports multiple source records per domain fact (M:N via record_provenance_linkages) and multi-step lineage chains via append-only parent_provenance_id DAG.
corrections_applied.correction_7_representative_dataset_reco: Four representative datasets reconciled against actual repository evidence; UNKNOWN used where evidence does not exist; Tamil Nadu 2026 retained as SCENARIO.
corrections_applied.correction_8_historical_backfill_boundar: W012 mandatory backfill strictly limited to the four representative acceptance datasets; bulk historical backfill deferred to W013-W017.
corrections_applied.correction_9_migration_impact: Single migration 039 planned with dependency inspection, enums, tables, indexes, FKs, RLS, transition invariant triggers, seed data, rollback blocks, and staging verification.
corrections_applied.correction_10_acceptance_evidence: Ten-point acceptance plan proving source, retrieval, effective period, version, status, transformation chain, scenario protection, historical integrity, immutability, and performance.
